Name: tiakall's Ancient Animals for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
The lovely [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/112768378]tiakall[/url] came to me and asked me to update and take over their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8662]Ancient Animals (BFAV)[/url]﻿ mod, so here it is, updated for SDV 1.6!

This mod includes 4 coop animals:

-Kenwe (from GBC Azure Dreams) - produces fire opals and dinosaur eggs
-Yacopu (from GB Trip World) - produces Fairy Rose Seeds and Rabbit's Foot
-Watabou (from GBC Dragon Warrior Monsters 1/Dragon Quest Monsters 1) - produces Mahogany Seeds and Starfruit
-Kirby (from GB Kirby's Dream Land 1/2) - produces tomatoes and starfruit

Enjoy!
